passages.text: Hey, morning! You're up early. Mom says the lake's calm today, so I figured we'd walk out there together. No rush. Well, a little rush.
passages.direction: Friendly, easy, a smile in it. The pace of someone chatting at a door. The last two words a touch quicker, as if he can't help it.

passages.text: Professor Rowan studies how Pokémon change as they grow. He's strict, sure, but he knows more about Sinnoh than anybody, from Twinleaf all the way north.
passages.direction: Explaining something he's proud to know. Even pace, clear names. Lean a little on 'strict'.

passages.text: Thanks for waiting. Seriously. I know I'm always running ahead, but it's good to have someone to run back to.
passages.direction: Warm and a little shy. Slower than his usual. A real pause after 'Seriously.'

passages.text: Did you see that? Turtwig, Chimchar and Piplup, all three, right there in the briefcase! I'm taking Piplup. No, wait. Okay, yes. Piplup!
passages.direction: Fast and bright, words tumbling over each other. The three names clear. The 'No, wait' a real change of mind, then the last 'Piplup!' decided.

passages.text: Come on, come on, come on! Sandgem Town is just past the tall grass, and then Jubilife City, and then Oreburgh, and then everywhere!
passages.direction: Impatient, bouncing on his toes. Speed up through the list of places and land big on 'everywhere'.

passages.text: First badge, second badge, third badge! I'm going to win all eight before lunch. Okay, before dinner. Before next week, tops!
passages.direction: Showing off, counting on his fingers. Each correction a step down in confidence but not in energy.

passages.text: You and me, we're going to be the strongest trainers in the whole region. Champion strong! Shake on it. Right now!
passages.direction: Fired up and sincere. Build to 'Champion strong!' and hold a hand out on 'Shake on it'.

passages.text: Hey! Over here! Wait up! You can't just walk off while I'm in the middle of telling you something!
passages.direction: Calling across a street, not screaming into the microphone: step back a little or turn your head aside, and keep the input where it was. Loud and offended.

passages.text: That's it, you're getting a fine! A thousand Poké Dollars! No, a million! Pay up the next time I see you!
passages.direction: Big, mock-furious, enjoying it. The number goes up and so does the voice. Same distance as the last one.

passages.text: What? I lost? How did I lose? I had a plan. It was a good plan. It just didn't work.
passages.direction: Stung, then sulking. Quick and sharp at first, slowing down and falling flat by the last sentence.

passages.text: The road's blocked again? Seriously? Every single time I'm in a hurry, something is sitting right in the way.
passages.direction: Exasperated, through his teeth, almost a groan on 'Seriously?'. Not shouting.

passages.text: My dad's a famous trainer, you know. Everyone expects me to be just like him. Sometimes I don't know if I can be.
passages.direction: Low and honest, nearly to himself. Slow. Let the last sentence trail off.

passages.text: The lakes... something's wrong out there. I can feel it. Let's be careful, okay? Just this once, let's actually be careful.
passages.direction: Serious, uneasy, the energy held down. A real pause after 'The lakes'. Quiet but not whispered: keep your usual distance.

passages.text: I wasn't strong enough to stop them. I keep thinking about it. Next time, I won't freeze up. I promise.
passages.direction: Ashamed, then resolved. The last two words firm and slow.

passages.text: Ha! Ha ha! Did you see its face? The Bidoof just sat down in the middle of the battle! Best day ever!
passages.direction: Real laughter if you can find it: think of something funny first. The words come out through the laugh.

passages.text: Okay, okay, I'll admit it, that was pretty funny. Me, falling into the fountain. Don't tell anyone. Ha!
passages.direction: Embarrassed giggling, laughing at himself. A short laugh to end on.

passages.text: Which way's the Pokémon Center? Left? Right? Is it the one with the red roof? Why is every roof in this town red?
passages.direction: Puzzled questions, each one rising at its end. Getting faster and more baffled toward the last.

passages.text: So what did the Professor say? Did he give you a Pokédex too? Can I see it? Just for a second?
passages.direction: Eager questions, leaning in. Rising ends, and a wheedling 'Just for a second?'.

passages.text: Whoa! Look at the size of that Geodude! No way! Is that thing even allowed to be that big?
passages.direction: Amazed, eyes wide. Exclamations falling at their ends, the last question rising.

passages.text: Past the foggy path, the judge's lodge sits by the azure bridge. Measure twice, cut once, they say. I usually measure zero times.
passages.direction: A tongue-twister he's reading off a sign, then his own joke. Careful and clear on every sound; the joke deadpan.

passages.text: Twinleaf, Sandgem, Jubilife, Oreburgh, Floaroma, Eterna, Hearthome, Solaceon, Veilstone, Pastoria, Celestic, Canalave, Snowpoint, Sunyshore. I'm going to see every one.
passages.direction: A list read off a map, each name clear and separate, as the pronunciation guide says. Proud on the last sentence.
